text:
toni: heads-up: customer noticed two charges when a truncated stream retried — but weirdly the second charge hit a different quota bucket.
frank: different quota bucket? how are we assigning buckets for retries?
toni: initial provisional hit 'default-embeds' bucket, retry (routed to fallback model) landed in 'high-precision' bucket and billed again.
maya: aha. we bucket by model variant + route at time of charge. reconnect changed route+model -> different bucket.
ledger-bot: INFO ledger: provisional(session=tn-44,id=pc_77,tokens=450,bucket=default-embeds)
ledger-bot: INFO ledger: confirmed(session=tn-44,id=cc_33,tokens=447,bucket=high-precision)
frank: so reconciliation didn't map provisional->confirmed because bucket changed; ledger treats them as separate rows.
pm: product question: do customers see two different line-items? that's terrible UX.
toni: yes, console shows two distinct lines; support escalated.
ux: short-term UX: show "possibly duplicated" badge and group provisional items by session id when reconciliation hasn't happened.
maya: longer-term: we should normalize dedupe key for billing to be session+toolcall-hash so bucket changes don't break mapping. means ledger needs to accept an optional dedupe_id.
frank: that requires ledger change + router to attach dedupe_id on provisional write. Also need guardrails: if model swap legitimately changes cost, do we want to force dedupe?
pm: we need a policy: if retry happens within X seconds, dedupe; beyond that, charge separately. config per-customer.
toni: engineering plan proposal: 1) router emits X-Dedupe-Id computed from session+payload. 2) provisional writes include dedupe_id. 3) ledger matches on dedupe_id when reconciling. 4) console groups by dedupe_id until final.
frank: add metric: provisional_grouping_rate and fraction of prov->confirmed with bucket mismatch.
ux: I'll draft UI copy for grouping and refund flow.
pm: file a cross-team task and prioritize P2. create canary for 5% traffic.
frank: note: ensure we don't leak dedupe ids for privacy; hash with salt per-org.
toni: opened TASK-9023 with traces. tagging ledger and billing. Thanks everyone.
